title: A land first pass of a code item that ends not done yet with no merge to wait for leaves its run state at landing, which runs lists as drift and claim and stage-back read as a land still running
goal: land moves the run state of a code item whose first pass ended not done yet with no pending merge request (a code branch gone and no merge found) to refused naming the step merge request, so no run state stays landing with no land running; the same with --wait-merge 0; a first pass that landed the item leaves its run state landed

run:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, types
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import backlog, bl_land
r = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(r), *a], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
g("init", "-q")
(r / "backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir": "items"}))
(r / "items").mkdir()
backlog.OUTPUT_ROOT[0] = str(r)
iid = "ST-aaaaaaaa"
bl_land.need = lambda bl, i: iid
bl_land.take_run(iid, "claimed", "claim")
bl_land.take_run(iid, "working", "dispatch")
bl_land.take_run(iid, "returned", "dispatch")
# the first pass of a code item ends not done yet and finds no merge request to wait for (the merge request merged and removed its branch)
def first_pass(bl, a):
    bl_land.LAND_OPS["pending"] = None
    return 0
bl_land.land_pass = first_pass
bl_land.land_move_run(types.SimpleNamespace(root=str(r)), types.SimpleNamespace(id=iid, wait_merge=1800))
state = bl_land.run_state(iid)
print("run state after a first pass that ended not done yet:", repr(state))
sys.exit(0 if state != "landing" else 1)

g("init", "-q")

backlog.OUTPUT_ROOT[0] = str(r)
iid = "ST-aaaaaaaa"
bl_land.need = lambda bl, i: iid
for state, who in (("claimed", "claim"), ("working", "dispatch"), ("returned", "dispatch")):
    bl_land.take_run(iid, state, who)
def first_pass(bl, a):
    bl_land.LAND_OPS["pending"] = None
    return 0
bl_land.land_pass = first_pass
bl_land.land_move_run(types.SimpleNamespace(root=str(r)), types.SimpleNamespace(id=iid, wait_merge=1800))

sys.exit(0 if state == "refused" and step == "merge-request" else 1)

notes: Planner 2026-11-09 (SP-6aegt3bs): premise reproduces on main (repro exit 1: run state landing after a first pass with no pending request, also with --wait-merge 0, which the fixture shows). Check 3 (a first pass that landed the item keeps landed) passes before the work on purpose: it pins that the fix does not overwrite a landed state. Detail settled: land_move_run moves a state still landing after land_pass returned 0 to refused with step merge-request (ops_token of merge request), reading it from coord, never from the pass's own result.
